name: Pixel Agents (Stable Release)
postAttachCommand: node -e "const repo='pablodelucca/pixel-agents'; const api='https://api.github.com/repos/'+repo+'/releases/latest'; fetch(api, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'pixel-agents-devcontainer' } }).then(async (response) => { if (!response.ok) { throw new Error('GitHub API request failed: ' + response.status); } return response.json(); }).then((release) => { const asset = (release.assets || []).find((entry) => typeof entry.name === 'string' && entry.name.endsWith('.vsix')); if (!asset?.browser_download_url) { throw new Error('Latest release does not contain a VSIX asset'); } process.stdout.write(asset.browser_download_url); process.exit(0); }).catch((error) => { console.error(error.message); process.exit(1); });" | xargs -r -I {} sh -c 'TMP_VSIX=$(mktemp --suffix=.vsix) && curl -fsSL "$1" -o "$TMP_VSIX" && code --install-extension "$TMP_VSIX" --force && rm -f "$TMP_VSIX"' sh {} || true
